title: Ukraine Declares Open-Ended Ceasefire at Midnight — Russia Fires 3 Missiles and 108 Drones Within Hours, Racking Up 1,820 Violations by Morning
detail: On May 6, 2026, Ukraine's self-declared open-ended ceasefire took effect at 00:00 local time — but lasted only minutes before Russia violated it. The Ukrainian government had proposed the unilateral ceasefire on May 4 as a direct counter to Russia's separate announcement of a 'Victory Day ceasefire' covering only May 8-9 (tied to the Moscow military parade). President Zelensky challenged Russia to match Ukraine's open-ended, indefinite truce. Russia did not formally respond or agree. Within minutes of the midnight deadline, Russian forces fired 3 ballistic missiles and 108 Shahed-type strike drones across Ukraine. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 89 of the 108 drones. The remaining missiles and drones struck Kharkiv (7 private homes damaged) and Zaporizhzhia (industrial infrastructure facility struck). By 10:00 AM on May 6, Ukraine's Foreign Ministry documented 1,820 ceasefire violations by Russian forces, including artillery bombardments, ground assault attempts, airstrikes, and drone attacks across all sectors of the front. Foreign Minister Sybiha stated Russia had 'broken the ceasefire with drone and missile attacks,' with Ukraine responding 'symmetrically' per Zelensky. The episode underscored the fundamental breakdown in ceasefire diplomacy: three rounds of US-mediated talks in the UAE and Switzerland (January-February 2026) had failed to produce any framework, despite Trump's claims in December 2025 that 90% of a deal was agreed. The competing ceasefire declarations were widely seen as a propaganda battle rather than genuine de-escalation.

media.caption: Ukraine declares open-ended ceasefire at midnight May 6 — Russia violates it within minutes, firing 3 missiles and 108 drones, accumulating 1,820 documented ceasefire violations by morning
